segments.title: Big Beautiful Bill & Tuberville's Rats
segments.notes: Case covers Senate advancement of Trump's 940-page budget reconciliation bill (51-49), Medicaid cuts, debt ceiling hike, and Sen. Tommy Tuberville's 'inner city rats' rhetoric amid Alabama gubernatorial run; includes Gaza casualty update.

segments.title: Jeb's Well Incident & Yodeling Class
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget returns after absence revealing facial reconstructive surgery from a 40-foot well fall; he and Jeb's Dad (wooden board) attempt yodeling lessons via Beth Williams tutorial, triggering Jeb's panic flashback.

segments.title: Chat-Shared News Blitz
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reads viewer-submitted stories: Bob Vylan Glastonbury 'death to IDF' chant investigation, Melania Trump AI audiobook, African penis-theft panic as Russian disinfo, Earth's mantle pulse under Africa, MMA fighter electrocution, Disney Cruise child overboard rescue, EA Sports college basketball 2028, Liver King arrest, Lazio mascot handler penile implant eviction, 'gravity-defying boobs' trend piece, Lord/Sabrina Carpenter NSFW vinyl art, Jake Paul vs Chavez Jr., MrBeast AI thumbnail rollback.

segments.title: Coach McGurk vs. Bob's Burgers
segments.notes: Munch debates solo while Crum is muted; Munch rants about Coach McGurk's betrayal, police reports, Crum's jaw reconstruction, and Bellulia's disappearance; Crum awarded point via Hurt cover playback.

segments.title: Tonight I'm Crumbing to Get You
segments.notes: DJ C4 and ghostwriter produce R&B track 'Tonight I'm Crumbing to Get You' using Epidemic Sound beat; Coach McGurk records lead vocals (pitch-corrected), Eddie (serial killer) adds whispered backing vocals; song completed for 'Crumbs Across America' charity.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open as 'Pupido', later consults on Crum repair and devil contact during Munch & Crum.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Returns after well-fall facial reconstruction; co-hosts yodeling class with wooden-board father.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (spirit in timber). Bickers with Jeb from wooden board; suggests wood chipper disposal; recalls yodeling with Jet.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates solo against muted Crum; reveals Coach McGurk called police on him; claims he scrubbed Crum's 'male G-spot' press.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Mostly muted during debate; jaw described as taped back on after gorilla punch; Bellulia missing; police calls mounting.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: musical producer. Produces 'Tonight I'm Crumbing to Get You' with ghostwriter; routes Coach McGurk and Eddie vocals in Pro Tools.

characters.name: Coach McGurk
characters.notes: guest vocalist. Records lead vocals for Crum song under charity pretense; accused by Munch of police report; bills $600/10min.

characters.name: Eddie
characters.notes: backing vocalist (serial killer). Provides whispered threatening backing track; described as 'absolute pro' and easy to work with.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appears on camera; identified as Kendral Lamar; Case's editing partner on Split Fiction.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's canine cold-open before Case Blackwell details the Senate's 'Big Beautiful Bill' advancement and Tommy Tuberville's 'inner city rats' gubernatorial pivot. Jeb Nogget returns from a 40-foot well accident with a reconstructed face for a chaotic yodeling lesson, then Jeff Ripple runs a chat-sourced gauntlet from Glastonbury protest chants to MrBeast's AI rollback. Munch debates a muted Crum while airing grievances over Coach McGurk's police report and Bellulia's disappearance, and DJ C4 closes the broadcast producing a pitch-corrected R&B track 'Tonight I'm Crumbing to Get You' featuring Coach McGurk and serial-killer backing vocalist Eddie.
